items.response:
Yes to Hannah's pancakes on Sunday at 9, kids can play. I'll check the Okafor-Malhotra family calendar for conflicts before adding it.
Action: Text Hannah a yes, check the family calendar for Sunday 9:00 conflicts, and add 'Pancakes at Hannah's' if it's clear.

Nut-free lunch ideas for Leo: turkey and cheese pinwheels; pasta salad with chicken and cucumber; hummus, pita and veggie sticks; mini quesadillas with fruit on the side; and an egg salad sandwich with grapes. Check labels on anything packaged, since 'may contain nuts' warnings are common, and keep every item completely nut-free regardless of what the camp says. I don't have what you asked me about Biscuit and the ambulance, so I'll search for it rather than guess.
Action: Search our past chats for the Biscuit and ambulance question and tell you exactly what you asked and what I found.

From what I can see, nothing is still running: the Big Apple hours check on Thanksgiving Monday finished (open 8:00 to 20:00). One open question is waiting on you, whether to cancel or keep Leo's piano on Monday at 16:30.
Action: Double-check the task list for anything I missed and tell you only what's still going.

Sent. For car insurance, start getting quotes about 4 to 6 weeks before the renewal date so a new policy can start the day the old one ends, with no gap in coverage. You usually don't need to give notice to leave, but you should cancel in writing with an effective date, once the new policy is confirmed; check your policy for any cancellation fee.
Action: Send the school council draft, read the letter for the renewal date and cancellation terms, and set a reminder 6 weeks before renewal to start quotes.

I'm not sure which order you mean, groceries or food from near Te Aro? Groceries need to be ordered by 14:00 for pickup, so 15 minutes may not be possible if it's groceries and it's past that time.
Action: Ask what you'd like me to order and where, then place it as soon as you reply.

Night, Riya. Proud of you for shipping it.
Action: Nothing further tonight.

Enjoy dinner, and tell Leo the pool is open tomorrow from 7:00 to 20:45, with lanes free after 9.
Action: Nothing needed tonight.

Booking the 30 minutes you asked for, with an agenda in the invite: walk through the new onboarding flows, questions from Diego and Aisha, and next steps. Your 1:1 with Tom is Thursdays at 14:00, so if the 13th is a Thursday I'll avoid that slot.
Action: Check Diego's and Aisha's calendars and yours for an afternoon slot on the 13th, then book 30 minutes with that agenda.

Added: Tuesdays at 5:30 pm, Pam McConnell Aquatic Centre, starting tomorrow.
Action: Create the recurring Tuesday 17:30 event, with the end time from the registration email.

Sent. A menu that works for everyone: Sam is vegetarian with no fish, Grace has no shellfish, so I'd go fully vegetarian and seafood-free. Try a wild mushroom and spinach Wellington with roast potatoes and carrots, and a Pomegranate Rosemary Fizz for Grace: pomegranate juice, lime, rosemary syrup, topped with non-alcoholic sparkling wine in a flute. Dinner for 5 can be mostly made ahead.
Action: Send the text to Hannah, then write the shopping list and check the grocery store hours for Dec 31.

Two lines that stay out of Hallmark territory: 'Thirty-one years of making the rest of us look organized. The department won't be the same, and it shouldn't be.' Or shorter: 'You set the standard here, and the rest of us are still catching up.'
Action: Send both to Sam, and tweak whichever he likes.

Generally no: Ontario doesn't allow damage deposits, only a last month's rent deposit, and a landlord can't just deduct for scuffed walls. For real damage beyond normal wear, the landlord has to apply to the Landlord and Tenant Board, and scuffs from regular living usually count as normal wear. Diego can ask for the money back, and file an application if they refuse. Okay, I'll leave the LinkedIn job alerts as they are.
Action: Pull a plain-language page on this that Diego can read and send it to you to forward.

Sunday 8:30 to 10:00 pm is free after the run change, so I'll block it for the spy series. For your mom, I'll find a well-reviewed Mumbai sweet shop that delivers and show you two or three mithai boxes to choose from.
Action: Add the Sunday block, then search for Mumbai mithai shops with delivery, and check the address I have for your mom before ordering.

I'll get the data side moving. The breakdown I'd send is failed payouts for the last 30 days by receiving bank with counts and failure rate, and where possible a split of bank-side errors, since those already retry automatically.
Action: Run the query on payouts data for the last 30 days grouped by receiving bank, and send you a table you can use for Wednesday's roadmap prep.

Merry belated Christmas, Riya. Pyjamas at 11, a Lego truck built three times, and Sam asleep with Biscuit sounds like a very good Boxing Day.
Action: Nothing needed, enjoy the slow morning.

Before I text a yes: my notes say Leo doesn't do well with sleepovers yet, and he goes to bed at 7:45 on school nights, and tomorrow looks like a school day. If tonight is a Friday it's also pizza and movie night at home. Do you still want me to say yes?
Action: Hold the text to Hannah until you confirm. If yes, I'll send it and add the sleepover to the Okafor-Malhotra family calendar after checking for conflicts, and if no, I'll draft a warm decline.

Dust smell lingers, so an odour absorber like activated charcoal bags is the better fix compared to scented candles, which only cover it. I'd wipe surfaces and run fresh air in too.
Action: Find charcoal odour absorber bags in stock locally or with delivery before the week starts, then order the best-reviewed one and send you the confirmation.

Scheduled for 9:00. For Priya: the key question is whether the move is a step up or a sideways shuffle. Then ask who she'd work for in Toronto, what she'd give up where she is (people, housing, partner's job), whether there's a way back if it doesn't work, and where she wants to be in five years.
Action: Schedule the Slack message for 9:00 and turn those questions into a short text for Priya.

Saturday with Leo: morning skating on the Rideau Canal Skateway (he already loves skating), a beavertail break, then something warm and indoors for lunch. The afternoon can be the snow sculptures and kids' activities, with a hot chocolate stop before the drive. I haven't checked next year's dates or ice conditions.
Action: Check Winterlude dates for next February and the Skateway status, then send you a draft timeline for the Saturday and a note for Grace.

Pickup in store it is: the usual bag at Queen & Logan, and Sam can grab it. Aisha already scheduled a freeze notice in #payouts-launch for Thu 07:00, so this is a friendly reminder. Draft: 'Quick reminder that the release freeze runs from Thursday 12:00 to Monday 09:00 for the bank-partner cutover. Please hold merges and deploys until it lifts. Thanks, all.'
Action: Place the pickup order at Queen & Logan and tell Sam, and hold the Slack draft for your OK.

Here's a draft: 'To Neha and [his name]: Neha has been the smartest person in every room for years, so we're all relieved she finally found someone who can keep up. [His name], you have signed up for a lifetime of being politely corrected, and you look delighted about it. Cheers to you both.'
Action: I need his name to fill in the blanks, then I'll tighten it to the length you want.

Tell Leo: sirens sound like another dog howling, and dogs howl back to say 'I'm here!' Biscuit is a beagle, and beagles love to sing along. It doesn't hurt him, he's just joining the song.
Action: Nothing to book, I'll keep this explanation handy in case Ellie asks again.

Timing beats total screen time: screens in the hour before bed delayed sleep by about 19 minutes in a study of 1,200 kids aged 6 to 9, worst on handheld devices. It's from light delaying melatonin, games and short videos keeping kids wired, and screens crowding out wind-down time. What worked within two weeks: a fixed screens-off time an hour before bed, devices charged outside bedrooms, and reading for the last half hour, with weekday screens under two hours.
Action: Nothing needed, I can send a one-line version to Hannah's chat if you want.

Yes, it used to be late January. The season got longer: the 9/11 postponement pushed the 2002 game into February, and the move to a 17-game season in 2021 locked it into the second Sunday of February. Sunday is for TV, since it's the biggest audience of the week.
Action: Nothing needed.

Here's doctor's visit vocab, and from now on I'll format Spanish lists as a table with Spanish, English and an example sentence for Anki.

| Spanish | English | Example |
|---|---|---|
| el dolor | pain | Tengo dolor de cabeza. |
| la fiebre | fever | Tengo fiebre desde ayer. |
| la tos | cough | Tengo tos por la noche. |
| la receta | prescription | ¿Me puede dar una receta? |
| el síntoma | symptom | ¿Cuáles son sus síntomas? |
| la alergia | allergy | ¿Tiene alguna alergia? |
| el análisis de sangre | blood test | Necesita un análisis de sangre. |
| marearse | to feel dizzy | Me mareo cuando me levanto. |

Action: Save the table format as your default for Spanish vocabulary lists.

Ugh, it really is. Hope the commute treats you kindly.
Action: Nothing needed.

Noted: Dr. Moreau retired at the start of April 2026, and Biscuit's vet is now Dr. Kaur at Riverside Veterinary Clinic on Broadview Ave. I'll update his contact and look for a weekday after 5:30 next week for his annual shots and the rabies booster.
Action: Update Biscuit's vet contact, check Riverside's availability for next week after 17:30, and book the earliest slot that works with your calendar.

Texting Nate, no calls: 'Hi Nate, are the cabinets still arriving Monday?' He starts at 7:30 am, so he may reply early. I'll also pull his invoices into the reno sheet.
Action: Send the text to Nate, search your email for Northline Renovations invoices, and add them to the reno sheet.

Great, send it along. For subscriptions, I have Netflix (standard), Spotify Family, Crave, and The Globe and Mail digital, and I'll check that Disney+ really stopped billing after the March 2026 cancellation.
Action: Check your card statements and email for any Disney+ charge after the cancellation and the cancellation confirmation, then save the four remaining subscriptions to a note with amounts.

The offsite is Thu 12 Nov, but I need to confirm today's date from your calendar to count business days accurately. I'd count weekdays from tomorrow up to the offsite, and note where Tom's Q1 page (Fri 6 Nov) and the memo comments fall on the way.
Action: Count business days from tomorrow to Thu 12 Nov and send you the number with the deadlines marked.

For jammy yolks: lower eggs from the fridge into boiling water for about 6.5 to 7 minutes, then straight into ice water for 5 minutes. For ramen eggs, peel them and marinate in soy sauce and mirin with a little water for 6 to 8 hours or overnight, so they're ready tomorrow.
Action: Set a reminder this evening to boil and marinate the eggs.

Make one-bowl chocolate chip muffins: he can measure, stir and scoop the batter into the tin, and they bake in about 20 minutes, which suits someone terrible at waiting. They're best a few hours after baking, so Wednesday morning works for an evening dessert. For January, a weekend-morning list of baking projects that get a bit harder each week would fit your plan.
Action: Send you the recipe and shopping list for Wednesday, and offer a January list of baking projects for you and Leo.

Sorry about that. The claim goes through Belairdirect, policy BD-AU-7731904 for the 2019 CX-5, not Intact. Before I file, take photos of the scratch and dent, note the lot and time, and check your deductible against the repair cost, since a claim can raise your premium.
Action: Pull the policy and deductible from Drive /Household/Car/Insurance, ask you for photos, and start the claim with Belairdirect once you OK it.

I'll rename them with the scan date as YYYY-MM-DD, using the date embedded in each PDF when there is one and the file date otherwise. If two scans share a date I'll add a number. I'll keep a rename log so it's easy to undo.
Action: Find all Scan_*.pdf in Downloads, rename them, and send you the count and the log.

Honestly a fair question, they'd need a very big cake. Long day, hope you get to sit down soon.
Action: Nothing needed.

I'll build a family-style order from Pai for three at 6, under $100, and keep it cilantro-free for you and fully nut-free for Leo. That means skipping dishes with peanuts or cashews and noting both on the order.
Action: Pick a mix of dishes from the Pai menu with no cilantro or nuts, add both notes, set delivery for 18:00, and send you the total to confirm it's under $100.

I don't have what you said about unwinding on weekends, so I'd rather find it than guess. Once I do, I'll shape a low-effort plan for tomorrow around it.
Action: Search your notes and past chats for what you said helps you unwind, then send you a simple plan for tomorrow that fits what's on the calendar.

I haven't read the renewal yet, so no verdict on what changed. When I have, the net premium change comes first, then bullets for coverage limits, deductibles and any added or dropped coverages.
Action: Find the renewal documents and last year's policy, compare them, and send you the net change first, then bullets.

Let's decide it with numbers. It's worth renewing if what you save at Costco beats the membership fee, so I'll look at what you actually bought this past year.
Action: Pull the last 12 months of Costco purchases from email and card statements, compare them to the renewal fee in CAD, and give you a keep or cancel call with the break-even.

A chipped front tooth is worth getting seen quickly. Dr. Lin is at Danforth Smiles, 822 Danforth Ave, 416-555-0182, and Leo already has a checkup booked there on Tue 2026-11-03 at 8:45 am. I'll ask for an earlier after-school slot this week for the chip. If the new visit replaces that checkup, cancellation needs 48 hours' notice.
Action: Contact the Danforth Smiles office for an after-school appointment this week, and check the drive time from home to 822 Danforth.

Draft to Mummy: 'Beta, from this week let's talk on Saturdays at 8:30 am my time, which is 6:00 pm for you. Sunday mornings are taken by Leo's soccer now. Kabir, same time for you.' I'll also fix your calendar and let Kabir know.
Action: Send the reply to Mummy, end the Sunday series and create the Saturday 8:30 am series starting this week, and text Kabir the new time.

Two is a respectable number, and no regrets is the right call. Dundas custard tarts are hard to resist.
Action: Nothing needed.

Noted: the mid-year self-review is due in Lattice on 2026-07-10. With the plumber coming Monday morning, I'd put the start reminder on Tuesday 30 Jun, then another on Monday 6 Jul.
Action: Add the Lattice self-review due Fri 10 Jul to your list, with reminders on Tue 30 Jun and Mon 6 Jul.

Posting the Slack message. Tom likes single-malt Scotch, especially Lagavulin, and Lagavulin 16 is about $150 at the LCBO. Since that's over $100, I'd check with you before buying it.
Action: Post the message to #payouts-launch, and hold the Lagavulin 16 order until you confirm.

Will do after the review. I'll put Nate's revised quote next to your $48,000 budget and track how much of the 10% contingency is used so far. I need to know whether the contingency is 10% of the base or 10% of the total, since that changes the amount.
Action: Pull Nate's revised quote and the budget sheet, and build a side-by-side with the contingency tracker for after the review.
